title.label: No spambot enforcement, too many prompts to complete a report

content.label:
There are way too many accounts from India/israel that are spamming western accounts. Instagram is not keeping the trust and safety of honest and compliant users. There’s too many spam bot accounts being created and instagrams approval/deny AI is failing to remove them even when they are blatantly breaking ToS and reported. Instagram is not listening to its reasonable and prudent users who want to keep the community safe through regulation on public and private accounts. When a report is submitted there are too many prompt notifications in the submission process and makes it painstakingly frustrating when the spam account is large. Under 13 accounts are also far too great in number to be considered adequately enforced. Who ever Instagram may be using to regulate this access and administratively remove all of the aforementioned accounts is failing their employer. These ToS report submissions should not be meaningless and reviewed on years end. These executive decisions to deny and ignore user’s right to protect themselves from unwarranted harassment is shameful as well as hypocritical when compared to the intensity of (western) election year scrutiny in years past’s contextless denials.
